text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm, hmm, hmm~♪ Is it ready yet~♪ Where's 
my soy sauce ramen, I wonder~♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I'm sorry. How unladylike of me before 
a meal.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I ain't said nothin', did I?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "No. Your eyes told the whole story."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Like, "She eats the exact same thing every 
time, so why the heck does she get this 
excited?!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Is it really okay for 'Her Royal 
Highness' to be usin' words like that?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine because I was imitating Shakur! 
So, how was it? Did I sound like her? Was 
it spot on?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't sound like me... but you got the 
gist of it. Throw in 'the lyrics are too 
childish' and it'd be spot on."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Pretty much right on the mark, right? 
Amazing, isn't it! Even I can gather data 
and derive the answer just like Shakur, 
you know!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Before that, you should be lamenting the 
fact that data trashing you is piling up."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Why? Shakur, everything you say is fresh 
and impactful to me... They're things I 
want to cherish!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Don't treat this like a trip to the 
damn zoo. Idiot."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, no way! You have to cherish those 
words! If you say that again, I'm taking 
your roast pork!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That's not for you to decide, idiot.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ah! That's the second time~!!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Here you go! One soy sauce ramen and one 
salt ramen, order up! I threw in some 
extra char siu for ya!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh! Thank you very much♪ I will enjoy it!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Fine can have my portion. If I eat 
that, it'll exceed my fat limit.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Really!? Thank you~! Hehe, I knew you 
were soft at heart, Shakur♪"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That ain't it, today's fat intake is— 
...Whatever, just eat it already. And 
don't sing, got it?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes, understood♪ Well then... bon appétit!
